description: Native profession advancement and general equipment catalogues from pages 143-157.

entries.title: Profession Advancement Tree
entries.summary: Characters progress from Novice to Expert and then Master by purchasing alternating Minor and Major Talents and completing profession-transition milestones.
body: A Beginner begins in the Novice profession with Minor Talent 1: Basic Skill and Major Talent 1: Core Competency.
The Novice path ends at 38,500 cumulative XP and transitions into Expert. The Expert path ends at 60,500 cumulative XP within that profession and transitions into Master.
The source concludes that experience values may be adjusted to fit campaign balance and pacing. The wiki records the printed values as the default native progression.

tables.title: Novice to Expert Progression
rows: Minor Talent 1: Basic Skill; Major Talent 1: Core Competency
Transition to Expert; gain Minor Talent 1: Advanced Skill and Major Talent 1: Specialized Competency

tables.title: Expert to Master Progression
rows: Minor Talent 1: Advanced Skill; Major Talent 1: Specialized Competency
Transition to Master; gain Minor Talent 1: Expert Skill and Major Talent 1: Master Competency

Major Talent Progression from Novice to Expert

entries.title: Knife Technology Catalogue
entries.summary: Knives progress from damaged scavenged blades to Advanced Tech monomolecular weapons, increasing damage, durability, and melee defense.
body: Each knife tier records description, credit value, native damage dice, effects, and any defensive bonus.

tables.title: Knives
rows: Low durability and prone to dulling

entries.title: Pistol and Rifle Technology Catalogue
entries.summary: Pistols and rifles use six technology tiers with escalating credit value, damage dice, reliability, range, targeting, and ranged defense.
body: The catalogue preserves source damage values and defensive bonuses without converting them into another weapon framework.

tables.title: Rifles
rows: Better range than scavenged but less reliable

High-tech rifle with optics and modifications

sourceRefs.notes: Six pistol and six rifle technology tiers.

entries.title: Healing Item Catalogue
entries.summary: Healing items progress from scavenged first-aid kits healing 1d4 HP to Advanced Tech nanobot devices healing 5d6 HP with recovery bonuses.
body: The catalogue records direct healing dice and recovery-rate bonuses exactly as printed.

tables.title: Healing Items
rows: Heals 1d4 HP; basic bandages and antiseptic

entries.title: Armor Locations and Pack Catalogue
entries.summary: Head, body, arm, hand, and foot armor plus packs each use six technology tiers with location-specific defense, utility, and environmental features.
body: Armor is location-specific rather than a single unified suit value in this catalogue. Head, body, arms, hands, and feet each carry separate costs and defense bonuses.
Pack tiers increase carrying capacity and eventually add hydration, energy, climate control, and drone support.

tables.title: Head Armor
rows: +5 head defense; HUD and situational awareness

tables.title: Body Armor
rows: +7 body defense; active shields and environmental protection

tables.title: Arm Armor
rows: +6 arm defense, increased strength, and energy shielding

tables.title: Hand Armor

+6 hand defense, enhanced strength, and haptic sensing

tables.title: Foot Armor

+6 foot defense, mobility, shock absorption, and environmental shielding

tables.title: Packs
rows: Maximum capacity, environmental adaptation, energy supply, and assistance drones

sourceRefs.notes: Six tiers each for head, body, arm, hand, foot armor and packs.

entries.title: Communications and Sorted Resource Catalogue
entries.summary: Six communication tiers and six sorted-resource tiers define costs, reliability, security, repair value, and advanced technological utility.
body: This detailed equipment entry duplicates and expands the earlier crafting-resource reference so that the values are browsable from both equipment and crafting categories.

tables.title: Communications
rows: Short range and prone to interference
Satellite link, GPS, encryption, and data transfer
High range, real-time translation, secure communication, and AI assistance

entries.title: Trade Goods and Synthesis Salvage
entries.summary: General valuables and components reclaimed from Synthesis units use six tiers of credit value and practical or technological utility.
body: Trade items range from sentimental pre-apocalypse valuables to advanced prototypes. Synthesis salvage ranges from scrap components to cutting-edge technology with integrated AI or unusual capabilities.
The catalogue records credit ranges and source descriptions but does not define market fluctuation or legal restrictions.

tables.title: Items of Trade Value
rows: Preserved food, makeshift tools, and practical goods
Designer clothing, electronics, and high-quality goods

tables.title: Items Reclaimed from Enemy Synthesis Units
rows: Basic components for minor repair and modification
Functional but unreliable parts and weapons
Top-tier technology, often with integrated AI or advanced functions

sourceRefs.notes: Six trade-value tiers and six Synthesis salvage tiers.
